agent.wait.title: Render PR wait or cleanup steps
agent.wait.summary: Run `forge agent wait <n>` after the PR opens and after each push; do each step, then follow `then`. `--sweep` on session resume; `--done` at land, abandon or handback.

agent.guard.title: Render a done-claim guard configuration
agent.guard.summary: Print a mergeable Stop hook using the installed package companion. Name an adapter or detect exactly one harness. Install the printed entry yourself, preserving existing settings.

route.get.title: Get a role's agent route
route.get.summary: Use the current model at high effort and standard speed. A matched adapter loses to any matched adapter whose over list names it. Detect the sole remaining adapter, inheriting omitted fields from the first matched adapter in its over list; otherwise use current. Max requires ~/.forge/routing.yaml.
